title.narrative: GPE Results and Value For Money assessment

description.narrative: Assess effectiveness, efficiency, and impact of GPE's investments across its funding windows and modalities, comparing financial costs, direct and indirect, with outcomes for children.

The review will assess the effectiveness, efficiency, and impact of GPE's investments across its funding windows and modalities. It will consider both direct financial costs (monetary disbursements, administrative expenses) and indirect costs (human resources, technical assistance) across funding windows/modalities and determine the total cost of GPE’s operations and interventions, comparing the costs with outcomes.
As a major donor to GPE, with 250 million DKK annually in core contribution, this review will be key as we consider future support to GPE, not least in light of the upcoming GPE replenishment in 2026. The review will complement the MOPAN assessment of GPE to be launched in December 2024.
NORAD has taken the initiative to conduct the review and has invited Denmark and IrishAid to have a stake in it. NORAD has contracted Genesis Analytics (GA) to carry out the review, on the basis of a wider framework contract between NORAD and GA, hence Denmark and Irish Aid would contribute to the financing of the review via NORAD.

Ultimately the beneficiaries of GPE funding i.e. governments in GPE partner countries and the basic education school students in these countries. In the interim the assessment will inform GPE donors Norway, IrishAid and Denmark about the strength and weaknesses in GPE results achievement and value for money.
